propositions: The autouse _no_repo_commits guard calls git rev-parse HEAD before and after every test, generating ~26k subprocesses across the 13,255-test suite and projecting ~75s macOS wall-time savings if eliminated.

Current guard must preserve per-test HEAD-move detection, test attribution, allow_repo_writes escape hatch, and session dirty-tree backstop while moving from two Git subprocesses per test to in-process HEAD fingerprinting.

Four surveyed active OSS projects (pytest, pip, Poetry, pre-commit) avoid per-test source-checkout Git subprocess calls, but no fidelity-preserving primitive (Git library, ref hand-parsing, or guard removal) reaches automatic-approval threshold for rebar's stricter checkout-attribution contract.
Operator disposition on 2026-08-19 accepted the ticket as wontfix; no implementation was automatically approved due to dependency-risk, correctness-risk, or fidelity tradeoffs.
